title: INR-XR-001 External Run Manifest v0
description: Top level: the runner-written manifest (evidence references and hash bindings only). $defs.raw_*: raw evidence data files (bundle-authored claims). $defs.adapter_result: adapter output only (structural result, evidence predicates, provider gates, assurance predicates, external assurance); never accepted as input. Checked with the code-owned vocabulary of docs/inr_001/schema_check.py.
